turns.text: That's great! Matcha is a fantastic alternative, and it definitely avoids that mid-afternoon crash. Have you been able to fit in any climbing or guitar practice around your work schedule lately?

turns.text: I brought a meal-prep burrito bowl that I made earlier this week. It's fully vegetarian, packed with black beans and fajita veggies, so it's super filling and easy to heat up between my calls.

turns.text: Yum, that sounds incredibly convenient and delicious! Perfect fuel for a packed workday. Are you still running much these days, or have you taken a break since finishing the Austin half marathon in 1:58?

turns.text: I'm still running, but definitely not at that intensity. I've just been doing some casual 3-mile jogs around the neighborhood to keep my cardio up. Running in the Chicago humidity during August is no joke, so I'm keeping it light.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I can imagine! Chicago summers can get incredibly muggy. It's smart to pace yourself and keep it casual. Do you have any plans to head to the climbing gym this weekend to escape the heat?

turns.text: Yes, actually! I'm planning to go early Saturday morning before it gets too packed. It's a great way to cool down in the AC and get a good workout in.
